1:
Urk... It's none of your business what I'm
doing!
2:
Well, sure, but... What's with that
worksheet?
4:
Huh, staying after school to study? That's
impressive.
8:
Just kidding. It's 'cause you scored 30 or
under on the last test, right?
10: Grrrrr~! Well, how did YOU do?!
12:
That's practically the same! You do the
worksheet too!
13:
Heh... You're naive, Astraea. It may be just
one point... but that one point weighs a
ton.
14:
Enjoying your freedom after school... or
staying behind doing worksheets... That's
how heavy that one point is!
16:
So, how's the worksheet coming? Let's
see...
17:
What is this? It's less math and more...
arithmetic?
18:
These are elementary school problems.
Let's see...
22:
(Whoa...?! She can't even solve
elementary-school-level problems?!)
24:
Uuugh... 3 X 4... What's that supposed to
mean?!
25:
(It's "times"! It's not an X! That's
multiplication!)
32:
I'll teach you. Even I can solve
elementary-school-level problems.
33:
I-I-I don't need that! I don't need you
teaching me anything!
35:
You read this as "3 times 4." It means how
much you get if you have four 3s.
37:
Look, there's a times table in your
textbook. Check it out.
39:
Look where 3 across and 4 down meet...
See? It says 12, right?
40: I see... Got it! The answer is 12!!
44: I-I knew that already, okay?! Idiot!
45:
Haha... That's only one problem, right?
Let's keep knocking 'em out.
47: Well, it's got nothing to do with me.
49:
31 points is basically the same as 30! Stay
and do the worksheet with me!
50:
Hey... Astraea, did you just barely scrape
a 30?
58: They gave me 3 points for writing my name!!
60: I-I see... Hang in there... okay?
62:
I can't do it for you, but I can at least
cheer you on.
66: Go for it, Astraea! You can do it!
67:
I believe in you! If you just try hard,
problems like these are nothing!
69: Yeah, don't lose your nerve, Astraea!
70:
What matters is effort, guts and fighting
spirit! You can do it if you try! That's how
it works!
72:
Give it everything you've got! Don't sweat
the details! Don't think, feel!
76:
Whoa?! She's writing her answers with so
much force!! M-Maybe this time...
